title: RangeSlider renders but isn't dragable?
body:
Type: Bug
Current Behavior: Renders but is not draggable
Expected Behavior: Draggable
Browser: Google Chrome Version 64.0.3282.140 (Official Build) (64-bit) (But happens on every one I've tested) 

Image: 
![](https://goo.gl/1wxaCM)

The element renders properly, except you cannot drag either end?

comments.body:
@Braunson, do you have this behaviour reproducible in a CodeSandbox (template [here]( https://codesandbox.io/s/github/algolia/instantsearch-templates/tree/master/src/InstantSearch.js))? It will be pretty much impossible to debug this without more information. 

Thanks!

Do you have any issues when you using our [tourism demo](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/examples/tourism/?q=&idx=airbnb&p=0&nR%5Bperson_capacity%5D%5B%3E%3D%5D%5B0%5D=1&nR%5Bprice%5D%5B%3E%3D%5D%5B0%5D=900) or the [storybook like demo](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/dev-novel/?selectedStory=RangeSlider.default)?

@bobylito No issues on either of those. I've tried different browsers with my code and it seems the only common items are:

1. Webpack
2. v2.5.0 version

This is a fresh install and use of `instantsearch.js`, I have no other vendor scripts or anything included. I am using `Laravel Mix` which is a webpack wrapper but that _shouldn't_ have anything to do with it.
I can't reproduce your issue. Can you provide a repro test case @Braunson ?
@bobylito Seems I can re-create it but only with [Laravel Mix](https://github.com/JeffreyWay/laravel-mix) and only for version 2,5,0+
@Braunson is there a way for you to share one example? Maybe using [surge.sh](http://surge.sh/) to share your static html page?

@bobylito I had issues with surge.sh and tried to re-create it in codesandbox.io without any luck reproducing it . It has to be something with Laravel Mix and it's webpack configuration or something. Since this seems to just be an issue I'm having I'll close this thread.
We still want to fix this for you! Can you make a laravel mix project we can clone?
@Haroenv Thanks for reopening, I've been away but tried to recreate this issue in a standalone Laravel Mix project and wasn't able to so I'm closing for now. Cheers 👍
